title: A Extraction for the Safehouse
author: Zephyrine Okafor
blurb: Rafael Blackwood, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
